name: readlearc
description: Readlearc — pay-per-read and pay-per-second publishing, fully on-chain. Vite + React SPA on Cloudflare Pages.

scripts.dev:cf: npm run build && wrangler pages dev dist --kv=RL_KV
scripts.deploy: npm run build && wrangler pages deploy dist --project-name=readlearc
scripts.contracts:test: cd contracts && npm install && npm test
scripts.contracts:deploy: cd contracts && npm install && npm run compile && npm run deploy
